doc.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18

title: Joe Mapu and the glass of wine with ice in his hand
summary: Darensbourg tells a joke about a New Orleans man, Joe Mapu, who outsmarts a bartender by asking for ice separately.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: the drink there. All right. You can change it. Yeah, give me a little liquor and a glass and put some ice in my hand. That's good. Used to be a joint in New Orleans. Yeah. Used to sell wine a long time ago. And had these big tall glasses, but they'd fill these glasses with the crushed ice. First and then they'd pour the wine in there. Yeah. And they had some guy around in New Orleans. His name was Joe Mapu. Yeah. And Joe Mapu was supposed to be kind of dumb. But he used to come in the place one day and he says, hey man, he says, he says, give me a glass of wine there. He says, but I want the ice in my hand. Separate.

He wasn't dumb. Bartender gave him a glass full of ice and he says, no, you fill that glass up with wine like you suppose. No kidding. And Bartender, he was kind of dumbfounded, but he filled the glass up. And old Mapu took and drank half of this wine and then took the ice that he had and it filled the glass up again. He says, you see that? He says, you guys say, I'm dumb. He says, no, I still got a full glass.
